plants.name: Tulipa gesneriana
plants.description: Cup-shaped blooms in saturated jewel tones rise on sturdy stems above blue-green leaves. Whole fields of tulips turn into bands of color, and they are a symbol of spring across the Netherlands.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid-April to early May in the Netherlands, with the peak usually in the third and fourth weeks of April
plants.location: Bulb fields and gardens of the Netherlands, especially around Lisse and Keukenhof
plants.funFact: In the 1630s, tulip bulbs sold for more than the price of a house in Amsterdam during the Dutch 'Tulip Mania.'

plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: Branches become clouds of blush-white blossoms that appear before the leaves. When the petals fall, they cover paths and water in pale pink.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to mid-April at lower elevations in Japan. Bloom comes later at higher latitudes and elevations, so it can still be seen in late April in northern Honshu and Hokkaido.
plants.location: Northern Honshu and Hokkaido, Japan, where bloom is later than in Tokyo or Kyoto
plants.funFact: Nearly all Yoshino cherry trees are clones grafted from a single original tree, which is why trees in the same area tend to bloom within days of each other.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: This tree does not bloom in April. It blooms in spring, which in the Southern Hemisphere falls in October and November, so it is not a good fit for this date.
plants.funFact: Jacaranda blooms in October and November in the Southern Hemisphere.
